mcp.binding_arguments_help: Use {id} for the issue key or page ID. Fill any other required values shown in the tool schema, such as a cloud ID.
mcp.binding_arguments_invalid: Document arguments must be a JSON object containing {id}.
mcp.binding_help: Registering a server and loading tools does not select a document reader. Choose Use for Jira or Use for Confluence on a discovered read tool, then save its document arguments.
mcp.binding_missing: Document reading for {source} is not connected. Register the server, discover its tools, then choose a document read tool for this source.
mcp.binding_read_only_required: Confirm that the selected tool only reads documents before saving.
mcp.binding_saved: {source} document reader saved. Preview imports to retrieve your references.
mcp.binding_server_changed: The server configuration changed. Discover its tools again before saving this reader.
mcp.binding_tool_not_read_only: This tool reports write or destructive behavior and cannot be used for document preview.
mcp.check_the_source_text_and_provenance: Check the source text and provenance. The registered coordinator selects read tools during preview and summarizes large saved Markdown files. Applied summaries enter the goal when you generate a plan.
mcp.confirm_read_tool: I checked that this tool only reads documents
mcp.examples_are_commented_replace_place: Examples are inactive comments. Replace every placeholder and remove the comment markers before saving.
mcp.discover_tools_then_copy_a_tool_name: Discover tools, then copy a tool name and its required arguments into goal_sources. Set read_only: true after checking the tool.
mcp.enter_a_jira_issue_key_or_numeric_co: Enter a Jira issue key or numeric Confluence page ID.
mcp.explicit_references_are_kept_in_your: Explicit references are kept in your goal. Adding one does not contact the server.
mcp.local_commands_run_only_when_you_req: Local commands run only when you request discovery or import. Remote connections use system curl; authenticate through environment-backed headers or a company-authenticated local MCP proxy. No model API key is required.
mcp.mcp_definitions_saved_no_server_was_: MCP definitions saved. No server was started.
mcp.paste_opencode_json_jsonc_with_an_mc: Paste OpenCode JSON/JSONC with an mcp map. Bind Jira and Confluence in goal_sources to exact read-only tools. Use {env:VARIABLE} for credentials; values are resolved only by the worker.
mcp.save_goal_before_preview: Save this workspace goal before previewing its references.
mcp.register_server_before_preview: Register and enable an MCP server in Settings before previewing references.
mcp.selected_source_evidence_approved_lo: Selected source evidence approved locally. Generate a plan when ready.
mcp.coordinator_required: Register an agent CLI and select it as the workspace coordinator before previewing sources.
mcp.invalid_summary: The coordinator must return a non-empty summary within 3 KiB. The full source remains saved locally.
mcp.source_evidence_changed: The saved source or summary changed. Retrieve and review a fresh preview.
mcp.summary_required: Summarize saved sources with the coordinator before using them for the goal.
mcp.no_read_tools: No eligible read tools were found on enabled MCP servers. Check server settings.
mcp.invalid_selection: The coordinator selected an unavailable server, tool or invalid action.
mcp.read_failed: The MCP read tool returned an error.
mcp.selection_exhausted: The coordinator could not select a document read tool after eight steps.
mcp.artifact_too_large: The MCP evidence exceeds the 64 MiB storage limit.
mcp.source_too_large: The document exceeds 4 MiB. Retrieve a focused document export.
mcp.automatic_tools: Your workspace coordinator chooses suitable read tools from the enabled servers. No document tool selection is needed.
mcp.catalog_empty: Discover tools for this server to inspect its catalog. The coordinator discovers them automatically when previewing sources.
mcp.reference_arguments_mismatch: The selected document arguments do not contain the requested reference ID.
mcp.loading_sources: Reading the referenced documents through MCP…
mcp.reference_not_read: {value1} — not read yet. Use Preview to read it through MCP.
